Team — forwarding Nexera's ask. Short summary / recommendation below and asking for executive signoff path:

Summary of request:
- One-time onboarding credit to cover ~2 months of pilot usage (customer expects heavy token usage during migration).
- Package VPC + Dedicated under a blended SKU for year 1 (they want a single invoice and simplified PO).

Why this matters:
- Strategic prospect in medtech pipeline; referenceable pilot with likely expansion in 2027 (projected ARR > $400k).
- Customer timeline: procurement/legal asks for written exec approval to accept any deviation from standard packaging/policy.

Proposed commercial carveout (my recommended starting point):
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 50% of estimated pilot spend (not to exceed $30k).
- Blended SKU for year 1 that nets ~10% discount vs published combination price, with the condition of a 12-month minimum commitment.
- Require standard SOW + written acknowledgement from Nexera that credits apply only to pilot consumption and do not change base rates thereafter.

Risks / mitigations:
- Margin impact: small but acceptable if pilot converts; propose using a makegood clause (reclaim any unused credit if pilot doesn't start within 60 days).
- Precedent: add a narrow carveout clause limited to Nexera and non-transferable.

Request: Markus — can you confirm authority for a one-time credit up to $30k and the blended SKU? Kimberly / Marissa / Jordan — can you validate the margin math and legal wording for the carveout clause? I can draft the memo for signature once we align.

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin — quick finance read below. I pulled estimates off the MAP attached: pilot projected consumption ~ $45k over two months.

Suggested terms (finance-signed):
- One-time onboarding credit = min(50% of pilot estimate, $22,500 cap) — this keeps gross margin impact capped.
- Blended SKU: 10% overall discount for first 12 months if they commit to a minimum annualized spend of $150k.
- Makegood clause acceptable: credit reclaimed if pilot not started within 45 days or if pilot is cancelled before go-live.

If Markus approves credit up to $22.5k we can fold this into the SOW and produce an internal memo for signature. Marissa/Jordan — I recommend adding an automatic rollback to published rates at renewal (no permanent SKU change).

Also flagging billing team for single-invoice requirement — we should use a billing note in the contract (Marissa to coordinate).

Kimberly

Team — reviewed. Approve the following, with explicit conditions:

1) One-time onboarding credit: approve up to $22,500 (as Kimberly recommended). Finance should mark this as a one-time, non-recurring concession and record under deal DL-2026-0098.

2) Blended SKU: approve a 10% blended discount for the first 12 months only, contingent on a written 12-month minimum commitment of $150k annualized. No SKU changes to catalog — this is a customer-specific pricing attachment to the SOW.

3) Conditions: makegood clause required (credit reclaimed if pilot doesn't start within 45 days); include a non-transferability and non-precedent clause. Legal to draft language; Sales Ops to record the exception and file for audit.

Soojin — you have exec signoff. Please send a short memo (one page) summarizing the approved concessions and requested signatures (VP/CFO). I'll sign the memo and route to CFO if needed.
